transcript: Mard, 44 saal. Kal raat se dast hai. Atenol dapha ho chukin hai. Dastimefrom nahi. Jism mein torythroxiparni ke kami hai. HB 10 ke baad. ORS ek khala. Flagyl 400 din mein teen baar, 5 din. Doodh Urtele hui cheezein band. Agar peshab kam ho jalan to foran Kaafi saal.

advice: Flagyl 400 three times a day for 5 days
stop eating foods that cause loose stools
if urine output decreases or burning occurs, come immediately
note.follow_up: if symptoms of dehydration or burning occur
